title: Deterministic FP8 mode selector and robust calibration for Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Marina Chen
description: Goal: Safely enable FP8 inference profiles on Hopper GPUs by adding a deterministic mode selector (chooses E4M3 vs E5M2 per model/shard), hardened per-layer calibration flows that tolerate activation jitter, and automated accuracy/rollout gates. This ticket scopes implementation, validation harness, and rollout controls for runtime-2.3.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Deterministic selector chooses a profile for each model/shard given fixed calibration seed and inputs. 2) Calibration produces stable per-layer scales across 10 calibration runs (std-dev < 1.5% for critical layers). 3) Accuracy regression vs FP32 <= 0.5% perplexity delta on representative LLMs (Llama-2-7B/13B, Red-pubic-3B) and <= 0.3% accuracy delta on classification evals. 4) Canary rollout can automatically revert to INT8/FP16 on customer-visible regressions. 5) Documentation + console flags present for toggling selector and calibration mode.
technical_notes: Design decisions: (a) Two-mode selector: E4M3 preferred by default for layers with low activation kurtosis; E5M2 used for layers identified with heavy-tailed activations or narrow dynamic range after per-batch statistics. (b) Determinism is enforced by a global calibration RNG seed and per-shard deterministic ordering of samples. (c) Noise/jitter filtering: apply trimmed mean and 1% percentile-clipping to per-batch scale estimates before percentile computation. (d) Stability: moving-average smoothing across calibration shards with dampening factor alpha=0.6 and fallback thresholds to INT8 if per-layer estimate variance exceeds 3x baseline. (e) Fallback policy: per-route runtime policy supports (i) model-level pin to FP8 profile, (ii) soft-fallback to INT8 with telemetry and (iii) hard-disable for impacted customers.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for deterministic selector logic and seed reproducibility.
- Synthetic activation replay: 5 datasets per model family (chat, completion, code) with fixed RNGs.
- End-to-end calibration runs: 10 repeated calibrations per model/shard; collect per-layer scale traces.
- Accuracy suites: perplexity on Llama-2-7B/13B, classification on SuperGLUE subset, generation-quality heuristics (ROUGE/BLEU) for summarization tasks.
- Performance: measure p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec on single-Hopper GPU with FP8 vs INT8/FP16.
- Canary: staged canary with 1% traffic -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on metric breaches (accuracy delta, error-rate, latency regressions).
benchmarks: Preliminary internal numbers (single-run): Llama-2-13B on Hopper A100-equivalent topology using E4M3 for most layers: +9% throughput, p50 latency -6ms; median perplexity delta +0.18% vs FP32. Observed failure mode: small set (~0.4% of layers) with heavy tails where E5M2 yields lower regression but slightly lower perf. Plan to encode those layer decisions into selector heuristics.
rollout_plan: 1) Internal dev rollout with synthetic workloads (complete). 2) Small internal canary (team-wide) for three models. 3) External: opt-in beta customers with explicit consent + telemetry. 4) Gradual ramp to all hosted models with automated rollback windows and release notes. Console controls: enable_fp8_selector (bool), calibration_mode (deterministic|stochastic), debug_collect_scales (bool).
